customManagers.description: Track the head of the v4 branch of ChristopherHX's gitea artifact forks. They publish branches, not tags, so the github-actions manager finds no version for '# v4'; git-refs resolves the branch itself, so its commits arrive as digest updates

packageRules.description: Skip @vitest/eslint-plugin 1.6.21: vitest/valid-expect false-positives on expect.any (upstream vitest-dev/eslint-plugin-vitest#924, fixed in 1.6.22 via #925). Remove once >=1.6.22 is adopted.
Hand ChristopherHX's gitea artifact forks to the git-refs customManager above, which can follow their v4 branch
Clear the release-age quarantine for ChristopherHX's gitea artifact forks: git-refs reports no release timestamps, so the quarantine would hold their digest updates pending forever
Keep ChristopherHX's gitea artifact forks on their v4 branch: the newer branches fail against Forgejo 17.0.1 (see ci.yml), so moving to one needs testing on Forgejo first
